assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:vladilena-milize@original-light-novels#86-vladilena-milize-character-reference-profile, the canonical CMR-4 Vladilena Milizé character reference profile (version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels V01-V14, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 excluded. The project's corpus map, the Character Modeling Reference method and the profile's own validation report were read for method, authority order and scope only. The ledgers L01, L02 and L09, specialist Documents 03 and 10, the relationship matrix, the diagnostic index, the CMR-9 audit, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. The profile's CMR-9 verdict and its HIGH, MODERATE and OPEN labels are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation, V15+ volume, Alter.2 scene or other character's profile is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The profile's six developmental states from V01 (morally right, positionally inadequate) through V13-V14 (political corrigibility, distributed command, unresolved overresponsibility), split where the profile locates a change inside a volume: V01 before and after Theo's name accusation, V03 before and after the memory self-correction, and V11 at the もう refusal of the tragic-Saint role. Alter.1 scenes are used only where the profile places them, the pre-service Annette outing and the loneliness after the Spearhead departure; other Alter.1 ordinary scenes carry no fixed position. The default is the V13-V14 boundary state. V10 has no diagnostic row. States after V14, the final arc's resolution, a postwar vocation or political role, and in-world calendar dates are not established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile gives a reconstruction thesis (moral recognition becomes responsibility, and responsibility becomes work), seven baseline traits, a behavioral grammar (attention classes, a notice-formulate-argue-take responsibility-revise sequence, a six-item intervention threshold, argued decision style, failure and repair styles), values with their risk forms, a twelve-row counterexample audit and an explicit prediction rule: moral salience, current role, available knowledge, relationship, bodily load and whether responsibility has become shareable. It predicts her mistakes: intervention threshold below certainty threshold, interpretive overreach about Shin and the Eighty-Six, overwork until collapse, and reasoning that becomes post-hoc to attachment or guilt under overload (V07 これしかない, V14 overdrive, V14 わたしのものだ). A would overclaim: it is one derived artifact that defers to narrower authorities outside this set, and T14-OQ-19 and OQ-20 stay open. C would understate the conditional account of what changes her response.

Six located developmental states (V01, V02-V03, V04-V06, V07-V10, V11-V12, V13-V14) with mechanisms: Theo's accusation (V01 ¶266) becomes the V02 practice of asking names, 忘れないで becomes 忘れたくない (V03 ¶106-110), V05 recognition of arrogance (¶930-931), V11 もう (¶356), the V12 rest mandate, and V13 code-switching and delegation. The Shin register is phased in four periods. C would understate changes that have located causes. A is rejected because the bins span several volumes, V10 has no diagnostic row, V08 and V12 are thinly sampled, and the final arc reopens overresponsibility rather than settling it.

A Japanese voice fingerprint: dominant わたし with printed 私 explicitly not a persona switch; です/ます carrying apology, command, affection and disagreement; self-correction in speech as a defining behavior; firmness inside polite morphology; deliberately theatrical 鮮血の女王 and 聖女 language; high-arousal breakdown forms (なんですか？, なってないです, 違いますってば！, V14 なんてことすんのよ and あんた); address that shifts by relation and time (callsign, then full rank, then シン in V13; ローゼンフォルト補佐官 later フレデリカ); 36 would-sound-wrong constraints. State, recipient and public or private function jointly constrain alternatives for illustrative textual Japanese, so C would understate it. A is rejected: the evidence is exemplar-based with no frequency or distribution, the L09 voice ledger is outside the set, and exemplars are not classified one by one by focalization.

Recurring tastes and episodes are located: tea against Annette's coffee, clothes, jewelry and two cakes before her service, shared mugs, cat food and a kitten, exercise clothes and weight worry, delight in real food, joining games because others look happy, birthday gifts, a household evening, a kept braid and bookmark, and asking for care only after days without sleep. Eighteen of the 76 scenes are Alter.1. B would overclaim: there is no account of daily routine or domestic sequence, and the asserted class-specific practical gaps are never specified. D would understate tastes and states that recur across pre-service, Alter.1, V07 and V11 placements.

Eight directed relations are analyzed. Shin is phased in four periods. Shiden's rough correction and teasing are accepted without being treated as insubordination (V08 ¶54 and ¶60, Alter.1). The Annette friendship predates the war and continues with revision, including the V11 correction (¶181). Frederica moves from title to given name. Raiden receives V14 delegation (¶354). The Processors, Republic institutions and her memory of Vaclav are also covered. Partner-specific conduct and its limits are discriminated, so C would understate it. A is rejected: the secondary relations are one paragraph with one to three scenes each, other Eighty-Six and Federacy superiors are barely sampled, and the matrix and L02 are outside the set.

Lena is a focalized subject, and the profile models private states and how they reach behavior: jealousy as irritation before self-recognition (V07 ¶625-629), avoiding the first dance for fear she will not let go (V07 ¶223), internal 'my dear subordinates' (V14 ¶340), wondering about touching sleeping Shin's face, loneliness after the Spearhead departure, rejection of guilt as her motive (V04 ¶577) and her own wish for happiness (V06 ¶528), plus nine emotional-state deltas with risks. C would understate located private states that are causally linked to conduct. A is rejected: focalization is not classified for each exemplar as the project method requires, the V14 father-pattern reading is offered as partial, and the post-V14 interior course is open.

Disagreement by naming the premise, with an explicit best mode (identify the assumption, offer a counterprinciple, state the ask, stay open) and worst mode (turn one real pattern into a total explanation and mistake urgency for entitlement to interpret). Located cases include the Theo and Kaie corrections, V04 interpretive conflict with Shin (¶183), the V05 retreat reframed in Shin's own logic (¶759), Shiden's correction, Annette's V11 correction and the V14 fury at Shin (¶554). Fear, care for Shin and time pressure tilt her toward the worst mode, so C would understate the response families. A is rejected: what decides between modes is only partly specified, and conflict with Federacy superiors is thinly sampled.

Values are restated as conduct with risk forms (equality, responsibility, freedom, trust, love, justice). Argued positions are located across the corpus: silence as participation (V01 ¶211), refusing to force Eighty-Six sacrifice for Republic citizens (V04 ¶77), stripping heroism from a mission (V09 ¶450-452), support or trust as opposed to obedience or demand (V12 ¶415-417), minimal kindness against eliminating disliked people (V13 ¶456), and seeing herself as hostage leverage (V13 ¶950-952). The profile states how she reasons (arguable decisions, defining the governing principle) and where it fails (certainty outrunning knowledge, post-hoc reasons under emergency). C would understate this explicit reasoning. A is rejected: novel competing-duty dilemmas outside these classes, and her postwar political stance, are not modeled.

Comic forms are listed (earnestness colliding with bodily or social reality, overexplaining when embarrassed, emphatic denial, clumsiness, food derailing a diet talk), along with comic partners (Shiden, Annette) and a negative rule against a permanently flustered heroine. Located cases include the V07 trip during the dance, the Alter.1 incoherent denial to Shiden, the fireworks wish within the V11 villain role, and joining games. B would overclaim: she is mostly the object of comedy, and when she initiates teasing or play, as opposed to being punctured, is not explained. D would understate the functions and partners the profile analyzes.

A dedicated canonical profile over the whole V01-V14 and Alter.1 boundary, with 76 routed diagnostic scenes: 50 on Phase-5 locators, 26 LOCATOR_GAP rows with EPUB paragraph routes, and 18 from Alter.1. B would overclaim: this is a derived compression of a principal focal character across fifteen books, the narrower authorities that control conflicts (L01, L02, L09, Documents 03 and 10) are outside the set, V10 has no row, V02, V08 and V12 have two to three rows each, and Alter.1 carries most ordinary-life evidence. D would understate coverage that reaches every developmental state with exact routes.

Affirmative, located constraints: 26 mischaracterization traps, 36 would-sound-wrong constraints, and a counterexample audit that narrows 'respects agency' (V04 interpretive overreach, V14 possessive crisis), downgrades 'romance stabilizes Lena' (V11 guilt, V14 overdrive) and rejects both the Queen-as-mask and Queen-as-true-self readings. V14 その人はわたしのものだ is preserved against a nonpossessive reading but not generalized, and the profile flags V07 これしかない as role enclosure. C would understate these located countercases. A is rejected: some constraints are profile rules without their own locator, and limits after V14 are open.

Each diagnostic row is located by volume and paragraph route. States are phased, with located within-volume changes at V01, V03 and V11, and Alter.1 placement is stated for the pre-service outing and the post-Spearhead loneliness. C would understate explicit period conditions. A is rejected: the phases span several volumes, the profile names no default state (this record sets V13-V14), most Alter.1 ordinary scenes have no stated position, and V10 is unsampled.

conditions: Illustrative textual Japanese only, never quotation, with わたし as default first person and printed 私 not treated as a persona switch.

State, recipient and public or private function are fixed jointly before register is chosen: polite and proposition-rich at baseline, high-arousal breakdown forms only in jealous, embarrassed, angry or emergency states, and theatrical Queen or Saint language only before an audience.
Address follows the attested relation and phase (callsign or rank in command, シン in private by V13, フレデリカ after the relation changes), and です/ます is not read as distance.
Self-correction mid-utterance is permitted and expected. Rough speech is not used as a marker of maturity.
No frequency claim, acoustic or anime performance, or V15+ state.
scenario_readiness.note: Evidence supports constrained illustrative output in the sampled states and relations. The lack of distribution data and of the L09 ledger narrows confidence rather than blocking use.

conditions: Chronology is one named developmental state, by default the V13-V14 boundary state. An earlier state is used only when explicitly selected, split at the located V01, V03 and V11 changes, and nothing after V14 is used.

The interlocutor is a profiled relation in its attested register: Shin, Shiden, Annette, Frederica, Raiden, the Processors as a commanded collective, Republic or Federacy institutions, or political interlocutors. Transfer to a comparable subordinate or peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition justified by the Shiden and Raiden patterns.

The situation matches a sampled class: command crisis, political or moral argument, correction from a friend or subordinate, grief or exhaustion with care offered, private romance with Shin, or ordinary leisure with friends.

Output states a tendency with the profile's qualifiers and predicts her characteristic errors (interpretive overreach, overresponsibility, delayed rest, possessive emergency rhetoric) as well as her strengths.

It abstains on the open domains (postwar vocation, a formal political role, how far she relinquishes interpretive authority, and how emergency attachment changes after the war) and introduces no institution, technology or relationship state absent from V01-V14.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named V01-V14 state, by default V13-V14: politically corrigible, delegating command, switching between command and intimate address, and still overdriving her body and capable of possessive fear.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Shin, Shiden, Annette, Frederica, Raiden, the Processors, Republic or Federacy institutions, or political interlocutors in their attested registers. A comparable subordinate or peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: Military command, political argument, friendship or subordinate correction, grief or exhaustion care, private Shin romance, or ordinary leisure
No post-V14 political order, postwar career or Alter.2 setting
No institution, technology or culture absent from the V01-V14 corpus

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded to sampled relations and situation classes. Settings and relations outside them are excluded rather than inferred.

conditions: Limited to the sampled ordinary classes: shopping or cafés with Annette, communal meals, group games, birthdays and gifts, household evenings, tea and drink preferences, exercise.
Tastes follow the profile (tea, clothes, cakes, dancing, gifts), and embarrassment and teasing follow the attested partners (Shiden, Annette, Shin).
No invented daily routine, domestic skill set or specific practical incompetence. Class-conditioned gaps are left unspecified, as in the evidence.
scenario_readiness.note: Recurring, located tastes and states support more than NOT_READY. The absent routine account blocks READY.

conditions: The dilemma maps onto an attested principle family: disposability or category-based exclusion, imposing sacrifice on people who did not choose it, heroic demand, freedom not to follow her, justice as an aspiration rather than an identity, or institutional coercion.
She is modeled as arguing the governing principle aloud and including herself under judgment, while allowing certainty to outrun positional knowledge.
Under emergency or attachment fear, her reasons may be post-hoc and are not presented as the series' mature position.
No resolution of T14-OQ-19 or OQ-20, and no postwar political program.
scenario_readiness.note: Located argued positions with their failure modes support bounded extrapolation within these families.

conditions: Only Lena toward Shin, in one named phase: V01 particularity, V04-V06 interpretive risk, V07-V10 jealousy and embarrassment through the V09 reciprocation, or V11-V14 care, grief and emergency possession. Alter.1 private scenes are used only as the profile places them.
Love is expressed by saying, arguing, promising, asking, remembering and protecting. It is neither perfectly nonpossessive nor governed by the V14 わたしのものだ line as a stable philosophy.
Jealousy is poorly concealed once strong, and romance does not cure her overresponsibility.
No postwar domestic outcome, no other romantic partner, and no V15+ relationship state.
scenario_readiness.note: The Shin relation is sampled across V01-V14 and Alter.1 with located state changes. Other romance is not assessed.

conditions: Republic Handler and Federacy command in attested forms: argued orders, refusing sacrificial logistics, theatrical Queen persona before audiences, asking a squad leader's judgment, delegating final action, accepting rest under medical or command mandate.
Command stress compresses speech but keeps her giving reasons when time permits. Exhaustion degrades her judgment of her own limits before her general competence.
No postwar career, formal political office, or institution outside V01-V14.
scenario_readiness.note: Command and political conduct are the profile's most densely sampled domains. Vocation after the war is explicitly open.

known_limits.statement: The source boundary is locked original-Japanese V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 excluded. No V15+ resolution is inferred. T14-OQ-19 (overresponsibility) and OQ-20 (limits of her interpretive authority) stay open, as do postwar vocation, a formal political role and how emergency attachment changes after the war.

Rest episodes (V12 mandate, Alter.1 collapse into sleep) and the V14 neural overdrive show overresponsibility as a persistent vulnerability, not a resolved trait. Romance supports her but does not cure it, and a healed-Lena model is unsupported.

V14 その人はわたしのものだ！返せ！ is preserved against a nonpossessive idealization, but it is a state delta under emergency fear, not her everyday relationship philosophy. Neither deleting it nor generalizing it is supported.

Her best collective formulations about the Eighty-Six and her readings of Shin are not authoritative biography for the people she commands or loves. The profile names this interpretive overreach (V04 ¶183, V09 ¶470) as a risk to reproduce, not a fact to inherit.

26 of the 76 diagnostic scenes are LOCATOR_GAP rows routed only by EPUB paragraph, and 18 come from audited-supplemental Alter.1, which carries most ordinary-life evidence. Their placement in the chronology is mostly unstated.

The profile defers to narrower authorities (L01, L02, L09, Documents 03 and 10, the relationship matrix and the diagnostic index) that are not curated on this subject, so conflicts the profile would route to them cannot be checked inside this evidence set.
V10 has no diagnostic row, and V02, V08 and V12 have two to three each, so states inside the V07-V10 and V11-V12 bins are coarser than the phase labels suggest.
Voice evidence is exemplar-based, with no counts or distributions of first person, politeness level or address by recipient and phase, and no acoustic or performed voice.
The profile asserts class-conditioned practical gaps without naming them and gives no daily routine or domestic sequence.
The CMR QA and CMR-9 gates are project-internal checklists. No retrospective or held-out reconstruction probe is in the set, which limits confidence but does not lower the tier.
